title: Billing Fee Rules — Early Termination and Thermostat Recovery Fees on Residential Natural Gas Supply
content:
**Status gate.** Gas termination fees are assessed only once the agreement is drop pending or closed, as the agreement's status in the company's records shows. Only one early termination fee line and one thermostat recovery fee line may be billed per agreement, judged from the fee lines already on that agreement's ledger.

**Termination date.** The termination date is the drop requested date for a customer cancellation, and the close date for a switch-away or a utility move-out.

**Remaining months.** The remaining months are twelve times the difference in years plus the difference in months between the termination date and the contract end date, plus one when the day of month of the contract end date is later than the day of month of the termination date.

**Amount by method.** Under the flat method the early termination fee is the plan's flat fee. Under the per-remaining-month method it is the plan's fee per remaining month multiplied by the remaining months, limited to the plan's ceiling. Under the none method no fee applies.

**Fee-free periods.** No early termination fee applies when the termination date falls within the plan's fee-free window of calendar days before the contract end date, equality counting as inside, or within the plan's rescission window of calendar days after the utility confirmation date.

**Waivers.** No early termination fee applies when the plan waives the fee on a move and either the close reason is a move-out or the premise carries a utility move-out date on or before the termination date plus 30 calendar days; nor when the plan waives the fee for assistance program customers and the customer's assistance program is the utility cap program.

**State cap.** The early termination fee is finally limited to the state cap for the premise's service state when that state appears in the plan's state cap list.

**Thermostat recovery fee.** Separately, when a thermostat was shipped and the termination date is no later than the plan's recovery period in calendar months after the thermostat ship date, a thermostat recovery fee of the plan's recovery fee amount is billed. It is not reduced by the fee-free window, the state cap or the assistance waiver, and it is waived on a move-out only when the plan waives the recovery fee on a move-out.

**Lines.** The two fees are additive and each is posted as its own line; a waived fee posts no line.

### Remaining months worked through (hypothetical dates)

| Termination date | Contract end date | Years and months difference | End day later than termination day | Remaining months |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 12 March 2025 | 20 November 2026 | 1 year and 8 months, so 20 | yes (20 against 12) | 21 |
| 25 June 2025 | 10 December 2025 | 0 years and 6 months, so 6 | no (10 against 25) | 6 |

### Fee worked through (hypothetical premises)

- **Ohio premise, Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 24 figures (5.00 per month, ceiling 100.00), 21 remaining months:** 5.00 multiplied by 21 is 105.00, limited to the 100.00 ceiling; Ohio carries no state cap, so the fee is 100.00.
- **The same agreement at an Illinois premise:** the 100.00 is finally limited to the Illinois cap of 50.00.
- **Fee-free window:** with a contract end date of 31 December and a 30-day window, a termination date of 1 December (30 days before) is inside the window and carries no fee; 30 November (31 days before) is outside it.
- **Recovery fee:** a thermostat shipped 10 January 2025 and a termination date of 30 September 2025 fall within a 12-month recovery period, so the recovery fee posts as its own line in addition to any early termination fee, unaffected by the window, the cap or the assistance waiver.
